changes.source: 花和尚禅杖·救林冲

before.en: The Flowery Monk's staff · Save Lin Chong

changes.source: 【自定义据守】%s——守住聚义厅，击退所有来犯的官军！

before.en: [Custom Defense] %s. Defend the Gathering Hall and repel every imperial assault!
before.ja: 【カスタム防衛】%s。聚義庁を守り、攻め寄せる官軍をすべて退けよ！

after.en: [Custom Defense] %s. Defend the Hall of Brotherhood and repel every imperial assault!
after.ja: 【カスタム防衛】%s。聚義庁を守り、攻め寄せる官軍をすべて退けよ！

changes.source: 对面是会用农民采集、修工地建寨、按队列点兵来攻的电脑官军，大将各带四技能。采金伐木、修寨练兵，守住聚义厅并打穿「官军大营」即胜。骚扰它的农民、拆它的兵营能实打实削弱它。点「开战」开始。

before.en: The AI gathers with workers, constructs buildings and trains queued troops. Its generals each have four skills. Gather gold and wood, build and train, then destroy the Imperial Camp while defending your Gathering Hall. Raiding workers and barracks directly weakens its economy. Choose Start Battle to begin.
before.ja: AI官軍も農民で資源を集め、建物を建て、順番に兵を訓練します。敵将は四つの技を持ちます。採金・伐木・築営・練兵を進め、聚義庁を守って官軍大営を破れば勝利です。農民や兵営を狙えば敵の経済力を削げます。「開戦」で開始します。

after.en: The AI gathers with workers, constructs buildings and trains queued troops. Its generals each have four skills. Gather gold and wood, build and train, then destroy the Imperial Camp while defending your Hall of Brotherhood. Raiding workers and barracks directly weakens its economy. Choose Start Battle to begin.
after.ja: AI官軍も農民で資源を集め、建物を建て、順番に兵を訓練します。敵将は四つの技を持ちます。採金・伐木・築営・練兵を進め、聚義庁を守って官軍大営を破れば勝利です。農民や兵営を狙えば敵の経済力を削げます。「開戦」で開始します。

changes.source: 【对战】难度：%s。守住聚义厅，集结兵马杀过去，踏平官军大营！

before.en: [Battle] Difficulty: %s. Defend the Gathering Hall, muster your forces and destroy the Imperial Camp!
before.ja: 【対戦】難易度：%s。聚義庁を守り、兵馬を集めて官軍大営を踏み破れ！

after.en: [Battle] Difficulty: %s. Defend the Hall of Brotherhood, muster your forces and destroy the Imperial Camp!
after.ja: 【対戦】難易度：%s。聚義庁を守り、兵馬を集めて官軍大営を踏み破れ！

changes.source: 聚义厅被官军攻破，杏黄旗倒下了……

before.en: The imperial army has stormed the Gathering Hall. The yellow banner has fallen...
before.ja: 官軍に聚義庁を破られ、杏黄の旗が倒れた……

after.en: The imperial army has stormed the Hall of Brotherhood. The yellow banner has fallen...
after.ja: 官軍に聚義庁を破られ、杏黄の旗が倒れた……

changes.source: 花和尚暗护林冲·留解差性命

before.en: The Flowery Monk shadows Lin Chong · Spare the escorts
before.ja: 花和尚が林冲を陰から守る・護送役を生かす

after.en: The Flowery Monk shadows Lin Chong · Spare the escorts
after.ja: 花和尚が林沖を陰から守る・護送役を生かす

changes.source: 救下林冲，由鲁智深护送他和幸存解差活着走出野猪林。

before.en: Rescue Lin Chong. Have Lu Zhishen escort him and the surviving guards out of Wild Boar Forest alive.
before.ja: 林冲を救い、魯智深が彼と生き残った護送役を連れて野猪林を脱出する。

after.en: Rescue Lin Chong. Have Lu Zhishen escort him and the surviving guards out of Wild Boar Forest alive.
after.ja: 林沖を救い、魯智深が彼と生き残った護送役を連れて野猪林を脱出する。

changes.source: 听林冲求情，留董超、薛霸性命

before.en: Heed Lin Chong's plea and spare Dong Chao and Xue Ba.
before.ja: 林冲の嘆願を聞き、董超と薛覇を生かす

after.en: Heed Lin Chong's plea and spare Dong Chao and Xue Ba.
after.ja: 林沖の嘆願を聞き、董超と薛覇を生かす

changes.source: 押送队会自行深入野猪林，剧情不等任务按钮。北侧松林路近但容易暴露，南侧芦丛路远却更隐蔽；也可提前现身强救。救人后可直接结队出林，也可歇脚取得演义印；选中任一人下令，鲁智深领队、解差照应林冲。

before.en: The escort advances without waiting for task buttons. The northern pines offer a shorter but exposed route; the southern reeds are longer and safer. You may also intervene early. After the rescue, leave together or rest first for a Story Seal. Select anyone to give orders; Lu Zhishen leads while the guards support Lin Chong.
before.ja: 護送隊は任務ボタンを待たずに進みます。北の松林は近道ですが見つかりやすく、南の葦原は遠回りでも隠れやすい道です。早めに姿を見せて救うこともできます。救出後は直接脱出するか、休憩して原典の印を狙えます。誰か一人を選んで指示すると、魯智深が先導し、護送役が林冲を支えます。

after.en: The escort advances without waiting for task buttons. The northern pines offer a shorter but exposed route; the southern reeds are longer and safer. You may also intervene early. After the rescue, leave together or rest first for a Story Seal. Select anyone to give orders; Lu Zhishen leads while the guards support Lin Chong.
after.ja: 護送隊は任務ボタンを待たずに進みます。北の松林は近道ですが見つかりやすく、南の葦原は遠回りでも隠れやすい道です。早めに姿を見せて救うこともできます。救出後は直接脱出するか、休憩して原典の印を狙えます。誰か一人を選んで指示すると、魯智深が先導し、護送役が林沖を支えます。

changes.source: 先沿北侧松林或南侧芦丛暗中跟上，在棍落之前救下林冲。救人后框选四人，自己决定先歇脚照伤还是直接出林。

before.en: Follow unseen through the northern pines or southern reeds, and save Lin Chong before the blow falls. Then drag-select all four and decide whether to rest and treat his injuries or leave at once.
before.ja: 北の松林か南の葦原から密かに後を追い、棍が落ちる前に林冲を救いましょう。救出後は四人を範囲選択し、休んで傷を手当てするか、すぐに脱出するかを決めます。

after.en: Follow unseen through the northern pines or southern reeds, and save Lin Chong before the blow falls. Then drag-select all four and decide whether to rest and treat his injuries or leave at once.
after.ja: 北の松林か南の葦原から密かに後を追い、棍が落ちる前に林沖を救いましょう。救出後は四人を範囲選択し、休んで傷を手当てするか、すぐに脱出するかを決めます。

before.en: Lin Chong · In stocks
before.ja: 林冲・枷姿

after.en: Lin Chong · In stocks
after.ja: 林沖・枷姿

changes.source: 董超、薛霸把林冲引往幽深林里，鲁智深仍未现身

before.en: Dong Chao and Xue Ba lead Lin Chong deeper into the forest. Lu Zhishen remains unseen.
before.ja: 董超と薛覇が林冲を森の奥へ連れていく。魯智深はまだ姿を見せていない

after.en: Dong Chao and Xue Ba lead Lin Chong deeper into the forest. Lu Zhishen remains unseen.
after.ja: 董超と薛覇が林沖を森の奥へ連れていく。魯智深はまだ姿を見せていない

changes.source: 鲁智深保持距离，听见公人要害林冲

before.en: Keeping his distance, Lu Zhishen hears the officers plotting Lin Chong's murder.
before.ja: 距離を保った魯智深は、役人が林冲を殺そうと話すのを聞いた

after.en: Keeping his distance, Lu Zhishen hears the officers plotting Lin Chong's murder.
after.ja: 距離を保った魯智深は、役人が林沖を殺そうと話すのを聞いた

changes.source: 路已认清。隐在大树侧面，等解差押林冲到树下；此时不要攻击。

before.en: The route is clear. Hide beside the great tree and wait for the escort to bring Lin Chong. Do not attack yet.
before.ja: 道筋は分かりました。大松の脇に隠れ、護送役が林冲を連れてくるのを待ちます。まだ攻撃しないでください。

after.en: The route is clear. Hide beside the great tree and wait for the escort to bring Lin Chong. Do not attack yet.
after.ja: 道筋は分かりました。大松の脇に隠れ、護送役が林沖を連れてくるのを待ちます。まだ攻撃しないでください。

changes.source: 林冲求情

before.en: Lin Chong pleads for mercy
before.ja: 林冲の嘆願

after.en: Lin Chong pleads for mercy
after.ja: 林沖の嘆願

changes.source: 林冲开口求情。鲁智深收住禅杖，接下来的解缚和照伤由现场演出自然继续。

before.en: Lin Chong pleads for mercy and Lu Zhishen lowers his staff. Unbinding and treatment now continue automatically in the scene.
before.ja: 林冲が助命を願い、魯智深は禅杖を収めました。縄を解き傷を見る場面は、このまま自然に進みます。

after.en: Lin Chong pleads for mercy and Lu Zhishen lowers his staff. Unbinding and treatment now continue automatically in the scene.
after.ja: 林沖が助命を願い、魯智深は禅杖を収めました。縄を解き傷を見る場面は、このまま自然に進みます。

changes.source: 林冲：师兄住手！这是高太尉叫陆虞候买嘱的。既救了我，且饶他两个性命。

before.en: Lin Chong: Brother, stop! Marshal Gao had Officer Lu bribe them. You have saved me; please spare their lives.
before.ja: 林冲：兄弟子、お待ちを！高太尉が陸虞候に買収させたのです。私を救ってくださったのなら、この二人の命はお許しください。

after.en: Lin Chong: Brother, stop! Marshal Gao had Officer Lu bribe them. You have saved me; please spare their lives.
after.ja: 林沖：兄弟子、お待ちを！高太尉が陸虞候に買収させたのです。私を救ってくださったのなら、この二人の命はお許しください。

changes.source: 玩家带相送队到林边歇脚，照料林冲脚伤。

before.en: You brought the escort group to rest by the woods and tend Lin Chong's feet.
before.ja: 一行を林の端へ導いて休ませ、林冲の足を手当てした。

after.en: You brought the escort group to rest by the woods and tend Lin Chong's feet.
after.ja: 一行を林の端へ導いて休ませ、林沖の足を手当てした。

changes.source: 鲁智深当面喝令两个公人一路小心服侍林冲。

before.en: Lu Zhishen orders the two officers to care for Lin Chong throughout the journey.
before.ja: 魯智深は二人の役人に、道中よく林冲の世話をするよう叱りつけた。

after.en: Lu Zhishen orders the two officers to care for Lin Chong throughout the journey.
after.ja: 魯智深は二人の役人に、道中よく林沖の世話をするよう叱りつけた。

changes.source: 等幸存同伴都走到林口。鲁智深和林冲必须生还；四人歇脚后出林另计演义目标。

before.en: Wait for every survivor at the forest exit. Lu Zhishen and Lin Chong must live. Resting and leaving with all four fulfills a story objective.
before.ja: 生存者全員が林の出口に集まるのを待ちます。魯智深と林冲は生還必須です。四人で休憩してから出ると原典目標を達成できます。

after.en: Wait for every survivor at the forest exit. Lu Zhishen and Lin Chong must live. Resting and leaving with all four fulfills a story objective.
after.ja: 生存者全員が林の出口に集まるのを待ちます。魯智深と林沖は生還必須です。四人で休憩してから出ると原典目標を達成できます。

changes.source: 鲁智深倒下，林冲失了暗中护送的人。

before.en: Lu Zhishen fell. Lin Chong has lost his hidden protector.
before.ja: 魯智深が倒れ、林冲は陰から守る者を失った。

after.en: Lu Zhishen fell. Lin Chong has lost his hidden protector.
after.ja: 魯智深が倒れ、林沖は陰から守る者を失った。

changes.source: 鲁智深现身与解差交手，先制住他们再救林冲。

before.en: Lu Zhishen reveals himself. Subdue the escorts, then rescue Lin Chong.
before.ja: 魯智深が姿を見せて護送役と交戦した。二人を制圧してから林冲を救おう。

after.en: Lu Zhishen reveals himself. Subdue the escorts, then rescue Lin Chong.
after.ja: 魯智深が姿を見せて護送役と交戦した。二人を制圧してから林沖を救おう。

changes.source: 解差已制住。请让鲁智深走到林冲身旁，靠近后自然解缚照伤。

before.en: The escorts are subdued. Bring Lu Zhishen beside Lin Chong to unbind him and tend his wounds.
before.ja: 護送役を制圧しました。魯智深を林冲のそばへ進めれば、自然に縄を解いて傷を見ます。

after.en: The escorts are subdued. Bring Lu Zhishen beside Lin Chong to unbind him and tend his wounds.
after.ja: 護送役を制圧しました。魯智深を林沖のそばへ進めれば、自然に縄を解いて傷を見ます。

changes.source: 林冲没有走出野猪林。

before.en: Lin Chong did not make it out of Wild Boar Forest.
before.ja: 林冲は野猪林を出られなかった。

after.en: Lin Chong did not make it out of Wild Boar Forest.
after.ja: 林沖は野猪林を出られなかった。

changes.source: 林冲不能单独结算；等鲁智深和幸存解差一起到达林口。

before.en: Lin Chong cannot finish alone. Wait for Lu Zhishen and the surviving escorts at the exit.
before.ja: 林冲だけではクリアできません。魯智深と生き残った護送役が林の出口に来るのを待ってください。

after.en: Lin Chong cannot finish alone. Wait for Lu Zhishen and the surviving escorts at the exit.
after.ja: 林沖だけではクリアできません。魯智深と生き残った護送役が林の出口に来るのを待ってください。

changes.source: 董超、薛霸搀着林冲，跟随鲁智深踏上出林官道

before.en: Dong Chao and Xue Ba support Lin Chong as they follow Lu Zhishen onto the road out.
before.ja: 董超と薛覇が林冲を支え、魯智深に続いて林を出る街道へ歩み出した

after.en: Dong Chao and Xue Ba support Lin Chong as they follow Lu Zhishen onto the road out.
after.ja: 董超と薛覇が林沖を支え、魯智深に続いて林を出る街道へ歩み出した

changes.source: 林冲获救并活着离开野猪林

before.en: Lin Chong was rescued and left Wild Boar Forest alive.
before.ja: 林冲を救い、野猪林から生還させた

after.en: Lin Chong was rescued and left Wild Boar Forest alive.
after.ja: 林沖を救い、野猪林から生還させた

changes.source: 鲁智深救下林冲，依他求情饶过公人；董超、薛霸搀着林冲，四人一同出了野猪林。

before.en: Lu Zhishen saved Lin Chong and spared the officers at his request. Dong Chao and Xue Ba supported him, and all four left Wild Boar Forest together.
before.ja: 魯智深は林冲を救い、その願いを聞いて役人を許した。董超と薛覇が林冲を支え、四人は揃って野猪林を出た。

after.en: Lu Zhishen saved Lin Chong and spared the officers at his request. Dong Chao and Xue Ba supported him, and all four left Wild Boar Forest together.
after.ja: 魯智深は林沖を救い、その願いを聞いて役人を許した。董超と薛覇が林沖を支え、四人は揃って野猪林を出た。

changes.source: 鲁智深护着林冲，与幸存同伴一起离开野猪林；未能保全两名解差。

before.en: Lu Zhishen escorted Lin Chong and the survivors out of Wild Boar Forest, but could not save both officers.
before.ja: 魯智深は林冲と生き残った仲間を守って野猪林を出たが、二人の護送役をともに生かすことはできなかった。

after.en: Lu Zhishen escorted Lin Chong and the survivors out of Wild Boar Forest, but could not save both officers.
after.ja: 魯智深は林沖と生き残った仲間を守って野猪林を出たが、二人の護送役をともに生かすことはできなかった。

changes.source: 鲁智深倒下，林冲尚未脱险。

before.en: Lu Zhishen fell before Lin Chong reached safety.
before.ja: 林冲が危地を脱する前に、魯智深が倒れた。

after.en: Lu Zhishen fell before Lin Chong reached safety.
after.ja: 林沖が危地を脱する前に、魯智深が倒れた。

changes.source: 丧命；仍可救林冲出林，但不能完成留命章回

before.en: died. Lin Chong can still be rescued, but the mercy objective is lost.
before.ja: が死亡。林冲はまだ救出できますが、助命の原典目標は達成できません

after.en: died. Lin Chong can still be rescued, but the mercy objective is lost.
after.ja: が死亡。林沖はまだ救出できますが、助命の原典目標は達成できません

changes.source: 已有解差阵亡，仍可护送林冲与幸存者出林。

before.en: An escort has died. You can still lead Lin Chong and the survivors out.
before.ja: 護送役に死者が出ましたが、林冲と生存者を林の外へ護送することはできます。

after.en: An escort has died. You can still lead Lin Chong and the survivors out.
after.ja: 護送役に死者が出ましたが、林沖と生存者を林の外へ護送することはできます。

changes.source: 鲁智深提前制服解差，立即替林冲解缚

before.en: Lu Zhishen subdued the escorts early and immediately unbound Lin Chong.
before.ja: 魯智深は先に護送役を制圧し、すぐに林冲の縄を解いた

after.en: Lu Zhishen subdued the escorts early and immediately unbound Lin Chong.
after.ja: 魯智深は先に護送役を制圧し、すぐに林沖の縄を解いた

changes.source: 提前现身·救下林冲

before.en: Intervene early · Save Lin Chong
before.ja: 早期介入・林冲を救う

after.en: Intervene early · Save Lin Chong
after.ja: 早期介入・林沖を救う

changes.source: 暗中拦棍的章回已经错过。先制住两名解差；现场安全后，鲁智深会自然为林冲解缚。

before.en: The hidden intervention objective is missed. Subdue both escorts; once the area is safe, Lu Zhishen will unbind Lin Chong.

before.en: Lin Chong, Leopard Head, once teaches spear and staff to the imperial army of eight hundred thousand. A loyal, honest man of exceptional skill, he is ruined because Gao Qiu's son covets his beautiful wife. Gao Qiu's plots lead him into White Tiger Hall, send him into exile at Cangzhou, and burn the forage depot. On a snowy night, he kills Lu Qian and his other enemies, then becomes an outlaw after the Mountain God Temple ordeal. At Liangshan he kills Wang Lun, the White-Robed Scholar, and seats Chao Gai as leader. His long serpent spear earns him a place among the Five Tiger Generals of the cavalry.
before.ja: 豹子頭の林冲は、もと八十万禁軍の槍棒教頭。武芸に秀で、忠厚な人柄であった。美しい妻を高衙内に狙われたため、高俅の罠に掛かる。白虎堂へ迷い込み、滄州への刺配となり、飼料庫を焼かれる。雪夜に陸謙ら仇敵を手にかけ、風雪の山神廟の一件を経て憤然と落草した。梁山では白衣秀士の王倫を斬り、晁蓋を第一の座に据える。丈八の蛇矛を振るって天下に名を馳せ、馬軍五虎将に列した。

changes.source: 花和尚鲁智深，本名鲁达，渭州经略府提辖。为救金翠莲三拳打死镇关西，亡命途中于五台山落发为僧。倒拔垂杨柳、大闹野猪林救林冲性命、桃花村痛打小霸王周通，一条六十二斤水磨禅杖横扫天下不平。自言「平生不修善果，只爱杀人放火」，却侠骨柔肠，终于六和寺听潮信而圆寂，得成正果。

before.en: Lu Zhishen, the Tattooed Monk, was originally Lu Da, a garrison officer in Weizhou. To save Jin Cuilian, he kills the Bully of the West with three punches, then takes the tonsure at Mount Wutai while fleeing. He uproots a willow, rescues Lin Chong in Wild Boar Forest, and beats the Little Conqueror Zhou Tong at Peach Blossom Village. His sixty-two-jin monk's staff strikes at injustice everywhere. Though he says he has sought no virtuous fruit and loved only killing and burning, beneath his fierce exterior lies compassion. At Six Harmonies Temple he hears the tidal bore, passes peacefully into nirvana, and attains spiritual fulfillment.
before.ja: 花和尚の魯智深は、本名を魯達といい、渭州経略府の提轄であった。金翠蓮を救うため三拳で鎮関西を殺し、逃亡中に五台山で出家する。柳を根ごと引き抜き、野猪林で林冲の命を救い、桃花村では小覇王の周通を打ち据えた。六十二斤の水磨禅杖で、天下の不正を薙ぎ払う。「生涯、善果を修めず、人を殺し火を放つことばかり好んだ」と自ら語るが、その内には侠骨と優しい心があった。ついに六和寺で潮の音を聞いて入寂し、悟りに至る。

changes.source: 高俅，本东京市井浮浪破落户，因善蹴鞠得幸于端王（后即位为徽宗），一朝发迹、平步青云，官至殿帅府太尉。上任头一日便公报私仇逼走王进；此后设计陷害林冲、三番调遣大军征剿梁山皆铩羽而归。奸佞当权、误国害民，乃《水浒》第一等的反面人物。

before.en: Gao Qiu begins as an idle rogue in the capital's streets. His skill at cuju wins the favor of Prince Duan, later Emperor Huizong, and he rises rapidly to Grand Marshal of the palace army. On his very first day in office, he uses public authority to settle a private grudge and drives Wang Jin away. He then plots against Lin Chong and sends armies against Liangshan three times, returning defeated each time. A treacherous official whose power harms the realm and its people, he stands among Water Margin's foremost villains.
before.ja: 高俅はもと東京の市井に暮らす浮浪の無頼。蹴鞠の腕で端王、のちの徽宗に気に入られ、一朝にして出世し、殿帥府の太尉に至った。就任初日から公権力で私怨を晴らして王進を追い出し、その後は林冲を陥れ、三度大軍を梁山へ送って、いずれも敗れて帰る。奸臣が権力を握り、国と民を害する、『水滸伝』を代表する悪役である。

changes.source: 一丈青扈三娘，扈家庄庄主之女，生得秀美，惯使日月双刀。祝家庄交战时她擒住王英，随后被林冲生擒，送往宋太公处看管。祝家庄破后，宋江作主将她配与王英；此后迎战呼延灼，又生擒彭玘。夫妻同随梁山征战，征方腊时王英被郑彪杀死，扈三娘前去报仇，也被郑彪镀金铜砖打中身亡。

before.en: Hu Sanniang, the Ten-Foot Green, was the beautiful daughter of the lord of Hu Family Manor and fought with paired Sun and Moon sabers. In the fighting around Zhu Family Manor she captured Wang Ying, but Lin Chong then took her prisoner and sent her to Song Jiang’s father for safekeeping. After the manor fell, Song Jiang arranged her marriage to Wang Ying. Later, against Huyan Zhuo’s forces, she captured Peng Qi. The couple campaigned with Liangshan until the Fang La war, when Zheng Biao killed Wang Ying. Hu Sanniang went to avenge him and was herself killed by Zheng Biao’s gold-plated bronze brick.
before.ja: 一丈青の扈三娘は扈家荘の主の娘で、美しい容姿を持ち、日月双刀を使った。祝家荘をめぐる戦いで王英を捕らえたが、その後に林冲に生け捕られ、宋太公のもとへ送られる。荘が落ちると宋江の取り計らいで王英と結婚し、さらに呼延灼との戦いでは彭玘を捕らえた。夫婦で梁山の征戦に従ったが、方臘討伐で王英が鄭彪に殺されると、仇を討とうとして自らも鄭彪の金めっきの銅磚に打たれて死んだ。

changes.source:
曹正是开封府人，世代屠户出身，做得一手宰牲剔骨的本事，号「操刀鬼」，曾拜林冲为师。他替财主到山东经商折了本，入赘当地农家，经营酒店。杨志失陷生辰纲后与他交手，二人通名相识；后来曹正献计，将鲁智深假缚押上二龙山，骗开关隘，助鲁智深、杨志夺取山寨。

三山聚义攻青州后，曹正随二龙山众人归入梁山。大聚义时专管屠宰牛马猪羊牲口。招安后随军征战，征方腊攻宣州时，与王定六一同中了城上射下的毒箭，回营后死去。

before.en:
Cao Zheng came from a family of butchers in Kaifeng. His skill in slaughtering and cutting meat earned him the name Knife-Wielding Demon, and he had studied martial arts under Lin Chong. After losing the capital entrusted to him for a trading journey to Shandong, he married into a local farming family and ran an inn. He fought Yang Zhi after the loss of the birthday gifts, and they became acquainted when they exchanged names. Cao later devised a plan to take Lu Zhishen up Twin Dragons Mountain as a false prisoner, tricking the guards into opening their defenses and helping Lu and Yang seize the stronghold.

After the three mountain bands joined forces against Qingzhou, Cao followed the Twin Dragons group to Liangshan. At the great assembly he was put in charge of slaughtering livestock. He served in the campaigns following the amnesty. During the attack on Xuanzhou in the Fang La campaign, he and Wang Dingliu were struck by poisoned arrows fired from the walls and died after returning to camp.
before.ja:
曹正は開封府の代々続く屠畜業の家に生まれ、家畜をさばく腕前から「操刀鬼」と呼ばれた。武芸は林冲に学んでいる。富豪から託された資金を山東での商いで失い、地元の農家に婿入りして酒店を営んでいた。生辰綱を奪われた楊志と戦った後、名を明かし合って知り合う。さらに魯智深を捕虜に見せかけて二竜山へ連行する策を立て、関門を開かせて、魯智深と楊志の山寨奪取を助けた。

三山の一党が力を合わせて青州を攻めた後、曹正も二竜山の仲間とともに梁山泊へ入った。大聚義では牛馬や豚、羊などの屠畜を担当した。招安後も従軍したが、方臘征討の宣州攻めで王定六とともに城壁からの毒矢を受け、陣へ戻って亡くなった。

柴进号「小旋风」，是沧州横海郡的富豪，原著称其为柴世宗后裔，家有誓书铁券。他广交豪杰，曾接济林冲、宋江、武松等人，林冲落草梁山也得到他的引荐。

叔父柴皇城在高唐州遭殷天锡欺压，柴进前往探望。李逵打死殷天锡后，高廉将柴进下狱；牢役蔺仁为保全他，谎报已死，将他藏进枯井。梁山攻破高唐州，李逵下井救出柴进，柴进遂入山寨，后来与李应掌管钱粮。

征方腊时，柴进与燕青潜入敌境，化名柯引，成为方腊驸马，在最后攻打帮源洞时反戈相助。班师后授横海军沧州都统制，见戴宗辞官、阮小七被夺官，又担忧自己曾做方腊驸马而获罪，便托病辞职，回乡为民，后来无疾而终。

before.en:
Chai Jin, the Little Whirlwind, was a wealthy man of Henghai Commandery in Cangzhou. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Emperor Chai Shizong, whose family possessed an imperial charter of protection. He welcomed men from the martial world and supported Lin Chong, Song Jiang, and Wu Song. He also recommended Lin Chong to Liangshan.

Chai went to Gaotangzhou when his uncle Chai Huangcheng was oppressed by Yin Tianxi. After Li Kui killed Yin, Gao Lian imprisoned Chai Jin. The jailer Lin Ren tried to save him by reporting him dead and hiding him in a dry well. When Liangshan captured the city, Li Kui descended into the well and rescued him. Chai joined the stronghold and later shared responsibility for its finances and provisions with Li Ying.

During the Fang La campaign, Chai infiltrated enemy territory with Yan Qing, took the name Ke Yin, and became Fang La's son-in-law. He turned against Fang's forces during the final attack on Bangyuan Cave. After the campaign he received command at Cangzhou, but saw Dai Zong resign and Ruan Xiaoqi lose his office. Fearing punishment for having been Fang La's son-in-law, he pleaded illness, resigned, and returned home as a commoner. He later died without preceding illness.
before.ja:
柴進は「小旋風」と呼ばれる滄州横海郡の富豪で、原著では柴世宗の子孫とされ、家に誓書鉄券を持っている。広く豪傑を迎え、林冲、宋江、武松らを援助し、林冲が梁山泊へ入る際にも紹介状を与えた。

高唐州の叔父柴皇城が殷天錫に苦しめられると、見舞いに向かった。李逵が殷天錫を殺したため、高廉によって投獄される。牢役人の藺仁は柴進を救おうと、死んだと偽って枯れ井戸に隠した。梁山軍が高唐州を落とすと、李逵が井戸へ下りて救い出し、柴進も山寨に加わる。後に李応とともに財貨と兵糧を管理した。

方臘征討では燕青と敵地へ潜入し、柯引と名乗って方臘の娘婿となり、幇源洞への最後の攻撃で寝返って味方を助けた。帰還後は滄州の軍職を授けられたが、戴宗の辞官や阮小七の免官を知り、自分も方臘の娘婿だったことで罪を問われるのを恐れた。病を理由に辞職し、故郷で平民として暮らした後、病気の兆しもなく亡くなった。

after.en:
Chai Jin, the Little Whirlwind, was a wealthy man of Henghai Commandery in Cangzhou. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Emperor Chai Shizong, whose family possessed an imperial charter of protection. He welcomed men from the martial world and supported Lin Chong, Song Jiang, and Wu Song. He also recommended Lin Chong to Liangshan.

Chai went to Gaotangzhou when his uncle Chai Huangcheng was oppressed by Yin Tianxi. After Li Kui killed Yin, Gao Lian imprisoned Chai Jin. The jailer Lin Ren tried to save him by reporting him dead and hiding him in a dry well. When Liangshan captured the city, Li Kui descended into the well and rescued him. Chai joined the stronghold and later shared responsibility for its finances and provisions with Li Ying.

During the Fang La campaign, Chai infiltrated enemy territory with Yan Qing, took the name Ke Yin, and became Fang La's son-in-law. He turned against Fang's forces during the final attack on Bangyuan Cave. After the campaign he received command at Cangzhou, but saw Dai Zong resign and Ruan Xiaoqi lose his office. Fearing punishment for having been Fang La's son-in-law, he pleaded illness, resigned, and returned home as a commoner. He later died without preceding illness.

杜迁号「摸着天」，是梁山泊早期头领。林冲初到时，山寨由王伦、杜迁、宋万三人主持，朱贵在山下酒店接引往来客人。

王伦不愿收留林冲，杜迁曾当面劝说，指出柴进对山寨有恩，不该推拒他荐来的人。后来林冲杀王伦，杜迁与宋万、朱贵归顺新首领，留在山寨。随着晁盖、宋江先后主事，他也成为一百单八将之一，大聚义时列为步军将校。

招安后杜迁继续随军征战。攻打方腊的清溪时，他与邹渊一同死于马军践踏，列入征方腊阵亡将士名录。

before.en:
Du Qian, known as Touching the Sky, was one of Liangshan's earliest leaders. When Lin Chong first arrived, Wang Lun, Du Qian, and Song Wan ran the stronghold, while Zhu Gui received travelers at the inn below the mountain.

When Wang Lun tried to turn Lin Chong away, Du Qian openly argued that Chai Jin had helped the stronghold and that they should not reject someone he recommended. After Lin Chong killed Wang Lun, Du, Song Wan, and Zhu Gui accepted the new leadership and remained at Liangshan. He served under Chao Gai and then Song Jiang, becoming one of the hundred and eight heroes and an infantry officer at the great assembly.

Du Qian continued to campaign with the army after the amnesty. During the fighting at Qingxi against Fang La, he and Zou Yuan were trampled to death by cavalry and were recorded among the campaign's fallen officers.
before.ja:
杜遷は「摸着天」と呼ばれ、梁山泊の初期からの頭領だった。林冲が初めて訪れた頃は、王倫、杜遷、宋万の三人が山寨を取り仕切り、朱貴が山麓の酒店で人々を迎えていた。

王倫が林冲を追い返そうとすると、杜遷は柴進から受けた恩を挙げ、その紹介した人物を拒むべきではないと面と向かって諫めた。後に林冲が王倫を殺すと、宋万、朱貴とともに新たな首領に従って山寨に残る。晁蓋、宋江が相次いで主となる中で百八人の一人となり、大聚義では歩軍将校に任じられた。

招安後も従軍を続けた。方臘軍と清渓で戦った際、鄒淵とともに騎兵に踏み殺され、征討で戦死した将士の名簿に載っている。

龚旺号「花项虎」，浑身刺有虎斑，颈项刺着虎头，擅长马上飞枪。他原是东昌府张清手下的副将，与丁得孙一同助战。

梁山攻东昌时，龚旺被林冲、花荣截住，掷出飞枪却没有击中对手，失了兵器，被二将活捉。张清后来也被擒，三人一同归入梁山。大聚义时，龚旺列为步军将校。

征方腊攻德清县，龚旺与黄爱交战，追过溪流时连人带马陷入溪中，被南军乱枪戳死。呼延灼在杭州会师后向宋江报告了他的死讯。

before.en:
Gong Wang, the Flowery-Necked Tiger, had tiger stripes tattooed across his body and a tiger's head on his neck. He specialized in throwing spears from horseback. He was originally a lieutenant under Zhang Qing at Dongchang, fighting alongside Ding Desun.

During Liangshan's attack on Dongchang, Lin Chong and Hua Rong cut him off. His thrown spear missed, leaving him without a weapon, and the two captured him alive. Zhang Qing was subsequently captured as well, and all three joined Liangshan. At the great assembly Gong became an infantry officer.

During the attack on Deqing County in the Fang La campaign, Gong fought Huang Ai and pursued him across a stream. Both rider and horse became trapped in the water, and enemy soldiers killed him with their spears. Huyan Zhuo reported his death to Song Jiang after the armies reunited at Hangzhou.
before.ja:
龔旺は「花項虎」と呼ばれ、全身に虎の縞、首に虎の頭の刺青を入れていた。馬上から槍を投げるのを得意とし、もとは東昌府の張清に仕える副将で、丁得孫とともに戦っていた。

梁山軍の東昌攻めでは林冲と花栄に行く手を阻まれる。投げた槍が相手に当たらず、武器を失って二人に生け捕られた。張清も後に捕まると、三人とも梁山泊へ加わる。大聚義では歩軍将校に任じられた。

方臘征討の徳清県攻めで黄愛と戦い、追って小川を渡る際、人馬とも川にはまり、南軍の槍で突き殺された。呼延灼は杭州で本隊と合流した後、宋江にその死を報告した。

关胜号「大刀」，原任蒲东巡检，原著称其为关羽后裔，善使青龙偃月刀。梁山围攻大名府时，宣赞向蔡京荐举关胜。他与郝思文、宣赞领军直攻梁山，迫使宋江回援。

交战时关胜同时迎战林冲、秦明，渐感不支，宋江却收军罢战。随后呼延灼诈降，诱关胜劫寨中伏，关胜被擒。宋江解缚礼待，他便与两名同伴归顺。大聚义时关胜列马军五虎将之首，继续随军征战。

征方腊后生还，朝廷授他大名府正兵马总管。他在任上颇得军心；一日操练归来，因醉酒失足落马，得病身亡。

before.en:
Guan Sheng, the Great Blade, was originally a patrol inspector at Pudong. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Guan Yu and a master of the Green Dragon crescent blade. When Liangshan besieged Daming, Xuan Zan recommended him to Cai Jing. Guan led an army with Hao Siwen and Xuan Zan directly against Liangshan, forcing Song Jiang to return to defend it.

Guan fought Lin Chong and Qin Ming simultaneously and was beginning to struggle when Song Jiang called off the engagement. Huyan Zhuo then pretended to surrender and lured Guan into an ambush during a night raid. Song Jiang personally freed and courteously received his captive, who submitted with his two companions. At the great assembly Guan headed the list of the Five Tiger Generals and continued to campaign with the army.

He survived the Fang La campaign and was appointed commander of troops in Daming. He won the confidence of his soldiers, but one day, returning from a drill, he fell from his horse while drunk, became ill, and died.
before.ja:
関勝は「大刀」と呼ばれ、もとは蒲東の巡検だった。原著では関羽の子孫とされ、青竜偃月刀を使う。梁山軍が大名府を囲むと、宣賛が蔡京に関勝を推薦した。関勝は郝思文、宣賛とともに梁山泊を直接攻め、宋江を救援に引き返させた。

林冲、秦明の二人を同時に相手にして苦しくなりかけたところで、宋江が戦いを打ち切る。その後、偽って降った呼延灼に誘われて夜襲に向かい、伏兵に捕らえられた。宋江に縄を解かれ丁重に迎えられると、二人の仲間とともに降った。大聚義では馬軍五虎将の筆頭に挙げられ、引き続き従軍した。

方臘征討を生き延び、大名府正兵馬総管となって兵士たちの信頼を得た。しかしある日、訓練から戻る途中、酔って足を踏み外して落馬し、病を得て亡くなった。

郝思文号「井木犴」，是关胜的结义兄弟。关胜介绍他时说，他母亲梦见井木犴投胎而有孕，因此得名，并称他熟习十八般武艺。

宣赞荐举关胜征讨梁山，郝思文随行助战。关胜受呼延灼诈降之计被擒后，郝思文遭林冲、花荣夹攻，退走时又被扈三娘以套索拖下马，随后同关胜、宣赞归顺。后来出征凌州再被俘，押送途中由李逵、焦挺、鲍旭救出。

大聚义后他担任马军出哨头领。征方腊攻杭州，与徐宁到北关门侦察时遇伏被擒，遭方天定剐杀，首级被悬在城上示众；徐宁为救他而中毒箭，半月后也死去。

before.en:
Hao Siwen, the Wooden Dog of the Well, was Guan Sheng's sworn brother. Introducing him, Guan said that Hao's mother had conceived after dreaming that the corresponding star spirit would be born through her, hence his nickname. Guan also praised his command of the eighteen martial skills.

When Xuan Zan recommended Guan Sheng to lead an expedition against Liangshan, Hao accompanied him. After Huyan Zhuo's false surrender led to Guan's capture, Lin Chong and Hua Rong attacked Hao together. As he retreated, Hu Sanniang pulled him from his horse with a lasso. He then submitted with Guan and Xuan. He was captured again during the Lingzhou expedition, but Li Kui, Jiao Ting, and Bao Xu rescued him from his prison cart.

After the great assembly Hao served as a cavalry scout commander. During the Fang La campaign, he and Xu Ning were ambushed while reconnoitering Hangzhou's northern gate. Hao was captured and put to death by dismemberment on Fang Tianding's orders, and his head was displayed on the wall. Xu Ning was struck by a poisoned arrow while trying to save him and died half a month later.
before.ja:
郝思文は「井木犴」と呼ばれ、関勝の義兄弟だった。関勝の紹介によれば、母が井木犴の生まれ変わりを宿す夢を見て身ごもったことから、この名で呼ばれたという。関勝は十八般の武芸にも通じていると評している。

宣賛が関勝を梁山泊征討の将に推薦すると、郝思文も同行した。関勝が呼延灼の偽投降に誘われて捕まると、郝思文は林冲と花栄に攻められ、退くところを扈三娘の投げ縄で落馬させられた。関勝、宣賛とともに降り、後の凌州への出陣でも捕らわれたが、護送中に李逵、焦挺、鮑旭に救い出された。

大聚義後は馬軍の偵察頭領を務めた。方臘征討で徐寧と杭州の北関門を探った際、伏兵に捕らえられ、方天定によって凌遅刑に処され、首を城壁にさらされた。救おうとした徐寧も毒矢を受け、半月後に亡くなった。

扈三娘号「一丈青」，是独龙冈扈家庄的女将，原与祝彪定亲，善使日月双刀。梁山攻祝家庄时，她出兵助战，生擒王英，后来追赶宋江，被林冲擒住，送往梁山。

哥哥扈成随后向宋江求和，但祝家庄败后，李逵仍杀了扈太公一家，扈成逃走。宋太公收扈三娘为义女，宋江又安排她与王英成婚。此后她常与丈夫同阵出战，也曾用套索擒获敌将。

征方腊攻睦州时，夫妻奉命往清溪方向出哨，遇上郑彪。王英受法术惊扰，被枪刺倒；扈三娘救援并追赶郑彪，遭他回身投出的镀金铜砖击中面门，落马身亡。班师后她获追封花阳郡夫人。

before.en:
Hu Sanniang, known as Ten Feet of Green, was a warrior of the Hu estate on Dulong Ridge. Originally betrothed to Zhu Biao, she fought with paired Sun-and-Moon sabers. She joined the defense of the Zhu estate against Liangshan and captured Wang Ying. While pursuing Song Jiang, she was captured by Lin Chong and sent to Liangshan.

Her brother Hu Cheng later sought peace with Song Jiang, but after the Zhu estate fell, Li Kui killed the Hu household while Hu Cheng escaped. Song Jiang's father adopted Hu Sanniang, and Song arranged her marriage to Wang Ying. She subsequently often fought beside her husband and also captured opponents with a lasso.

During the assault on Muzhou in the Fang La campaign, the couple were sent to scout toward Qingxi and encountered Zheng Biao. His magic startled Wang Ying, who was struck down by a spear. Hu Sanniang went to help and then pursued Zheng. He turned and threw a gilded copper brick into her face, killing her as she fell from her horse. After the campaign she was posthumously named Lady of Huayang Commandery.

蒋敬是湖南潭州人，原是落第举子，后来弃文习武，精通书算，也能使枪棒、排兵布阵，号「神算子」。他与欧鹏、马麟、陶宗旺在黄门山聚义。

宋江、晁盖等人从江州救人后返回梁山，经过黄门山，四位头领迎接上山设宴。宋江邀请他们同往梁山，蒋敬等欣然应允，收拾人马财物同行。大聚义时，他专管考算钱粮收支。

招安后蒋敬随军出征，征方腊到杭州时还与裴宣记录众将功劳。班师受赏后，他因思念故乡，回潭州为民。原著没有交代他后来成为富户或何时去世。

before.en:
Jiang Jing came from Tanzhou in Hunan. After failing the civil examinations, he turned to martial studies. Skilled in accounting, he could also use spear and staff and arrange troops in battle. Known as the Divine Calculator, he formed a band on Huangmen Mountain with Ou Peng, Ma Lin, and Tao Zongwang.

When Song Jiang, Chao Gai, and their companions passed the mountain on their return from the rescue at Jiangzhou, the four leaders welcomed them with a feast. Song invited them to Liangshan, and Jiang and the others gladly agreed, gathering their men and belongings for the journey. At the great assembly Jiang was assigned to audit receipts and expenditures of money and provisions.

He campaigned with the army after the amnesty. At Hangzhou during the Fang La campaign, he also recorded the officers' achievements with Pei Xuan. After returning and receiving his reward, he went home to Tanzhou as a commoner because he missed his native place. The novel does not say that he later became a wealthy landowner or describe his death.

江州での救出を終えた宋江、晁蓋たちが梁山泊へ戻る途中で黄門山を通ると、四人は一行を山へ迎えて宴を開いた。宋江から梁山泊へ誘われ、蒋敬たちは喜んで応じ、人馬や財物を整えて同行する。大聚義では金銭と兵糧の出納計算を担当した。

招安後も従軍し、方臘征討で杭州に至った時には裴宣とともに諸将の功績を記録した。帰還して恩賞を受けると、故郷を思って潭州へ戻り、平民となった。その後に富豪となったことや死去の事情は原著に記されていない。

林冲绰号豹子头，原是东京八十万禁军枪棒教头。他与鲁智深结为兄弟后，妻子遭高衙内纠缠。高俅设局使他持刀误入白虎节堂，林冲被刺配沧州。董超、薛霸在野猪林行凶时，鲁智深赶来救下了他。

到了沧州，林冲被派往草料场。陆谦等纵火害他，他因雪压草屋，先到山神庙避宿，听见三人在庙外谈论阴谋，杀死陆谦、富安和差拨，逃往柴进庄上。经柴进荐引投奔梁山，又受王伦刁难，被逼下山取投名状。

晁盖等人上山后，王伦仍不肯收留。林冲在吴用激劝下杀了王伦，推晁盖为寨主。大聚义时，他位列第六，列入马军五虎将，此后随军出征。

征方腊结束后，林冲患风病瘫痪，留在杭州六和寺，由武松照看。过了半年，病重身亡。

before.en:
Lin Chong, known as Leopard Head, was a weapons instructor in the capital's eight-hundred-thousand-strong imperial guard. After he became sworn brothers with Lu Zhishen, Gao Yanei began harassing his wife. Gao Qiu arranged for Lin Chong to enter the White Tiger military hall carrying a sword, then had him sentenced to exile in Cangzhou. When his escorts, Dong Chao and Xue Ba, tried to kill him in Wild Boar Forest, Lu Zhishen saved him.

In Cangzhou, Lin Chong was assigned to a military fodder depot. Lu Qian and his accomplices set it alight to kill him, but snow had crushed his hut and driven him to shelter in a nearby mountain shrine. Hearing the three men discuss their plot outside, he killed Lu Qian, Fu An, and the camp overseer, then fled to Chai Jin's estate. Chai Jin recommended him to Liangshan, where Wang Lun put obstacles in his way and demanded that he bring back a stranger's head as proof of commitment.

When Chao Gai and his companions later sought refuge, Wang Lun again refused to admit them. Encouraged by Wu Yong, Lin Chong killed Wang Lun and installed Chao Gai as leader. At the grand assembly he ranked sixth and became one of the Five Tiger Generals of the cavalry, subsequently serving on the army's campaigns.

After the campaign against Fang La, Lin Chong developed a paralytic illness. He remained at the Six Harmonies Temple in Hangzhou under Wu Song's care and died six months later.
before.ja:
林冲は豹子頭の異名を持ち、東京の八十万禁軍で槍棒の師範を務めていた。魯智深と義兄弟になった後、妻が高衙内につきまとわれる。高俅の罠で刀を帯びたまま白虎節堂に入り、滄州への流刑となった。護送役の董超と薛覇に野猪林で殺されかけたところを、魯智深に救われる。

滄州では軍の飼料置き場を任された。陸謙らは林冲を焼き殺そうと放火するが、雪で小屋が潰れたため、林冲は先に山神廟へ避難していた。廟の外で三人が陰謀を語るのを聞き、陸謙、富安、差撥を殺して柴進の屋敷へ逃げる。柴進の紹介で梁山へ赴いたものの、王倫に難題を課され、入山の証として人の首を取ってくるよう命じられた。

晁蓋らが来た時も王倫は受け入れを拒んだ。林冲は呉用に促されて王倫を殺し、晁蓋を首領に推した。大集結では第六位となり、馬軍五虎将に列せられ、その後の遠征に従軍した。

方臘討伐の後、林冲は風病で身体が麻痺し、杭州の六和寺に残って武松の世話を受けた。半年後、病が重くなって亡くなった。

鲁智深本名鲁达，在渭州经略府任提辖。得知郑屠欺压金翠莲父女，他先资助二人脱身，再去惩治郑屠，三拳将其打死，遂逃亡。赵员外引他到五台山，智真长老收他出家，取法名智深。

因酒后闹寺，他被送往东京大相国寺看管菜园，倒拔垂杨柳，与林冲结为兄弟。林冲遭刺配，他暗中跟随，在野猪林救人，又护送到距沧州七十余里才分手。后来无法再容身相国寺，他与杨志依曹正之计夺下二龙山，杀邓龙，成为山寨首领。

三山聚义攻青州后，鲁智深随众归入梁山，担任步军头领。征辽归途中，他重访五台山，智真赠偈“逢夏而擒，遇腊而执，听潮而圆，见信而寂”。征方腊时，他在乌龙岭追赶夏侯成，迷路到山中庵院，后来在那里生擒逃亡的方腊。

班师至杭州，鲁智深不愿做官，留歇六和寺。八月十五夜听见钱塘江潮信，悟及师父偈语，沐浴更衣，写下颂子，坐化而逝。武松等将他葬于六和塔后山。

before.en:
Lu Zhishen was originally named Lu Da and served as a military officer in the commissioner's office at Weizhou. Learning that the butcher Zheng was abusing Jin Cuilian and her father, he helped them escape and then confronted Zheng, killing him with three punches. He fled, and Squire Zhao brought him to Mount Wutai, where Elder Zhizhen ordained him and gave him the religious name Zhishen.

After drunken disturbances at the monastery, he was sent to tend the vegetable garden at the Great Xiangguo Temple in the capital. There he uprooted a willow tree and became sworn brothers with Lin Chong. When Lin Chong was sentenced to exile, Lu Zhishen secretly followed, saved him in Wild Boar Forest, and escorted him until they were about seventy li from Cangzhou. Later forced to leave the temple, he joined Yang Zhi in taking Erlong Mountain through Cao Zheng's stratagem. He killed Deng Long and became one of the stronghold's leaders.

After the three mountain bands joined forces against Qingzhou, Lu Zhishen entered Liangshan and served as an infantry commander. Returning from the Liao campaign, he revisited Mount Wutai. Zhizhen gave him a verse foretelling capture upon meeting Xia, seizure upon encountering La, completion upon hearing the tide, and stillness upon seeing its appointed signal. During the war against Fang La, he pursued Xiahou Cheng at Wulong Ridge, lost his way, and reached a mountain hermitage. There he later captured the fleeing Fang La.

On the return to Hangzhou, Lu Zhishen declined an official career and stayed at the Six Harmonies Temple. On the night of the fifteenth day of the eighth month, he heard the Qiantang River's tide and understood his master's verse. He bathed, changed his clothes, wrote a final poem, and died seated in meditation. Wu Song and the others buried him on the hill behind the Six Harmonies Pagoda.
before.ja:
魯智深の本名は魯達で、渭州の経略府で提轄を務めていた。肉屋の鄭屠が金翠蓮父娘を苦しめていると知り、まず二人の逃亡を助け、それから鄭屠を懲らしめに行く。三発殴って殺してしまい、追われる身となった。趙員外の紹介で五台山へ入り、智真長老のもとで出家し、智深の法名を授けられる。

酒を飲んで寺で騒動を起こしたため、東京の大相国寺へ送られて菜園を預かった。そこで柳を根こそぎ引き抜き、林冲と義兄弟になる。林冲が流刑になるとひそかに後を追い、野猪林で救った後、滄州の手前七十余里まで護送して別れた。やがて相国寺にもいられなくなり、曹正の計略で楊志と二竜山を奪い、鄧竜を殺して山寨の首領となる。

三つの山寨が力を合わせて青州を攻めた後、魯智深は一同と梁山へ入り、歩軍の頭領を務めた。遼討伐の帰途に五台山を再訪すると、智真から「夏に逢いて擒にし、臘に遇いて執り、潮を聴いて円かに、信を見て寂す」という偈を授かる。方臘討伐では烏竜嶺で夏侯成を追って道に迷い、山中の庵へ至った。後にそこで逃亡中の方臘を生け捕りにする。

杭州まで帰ると、官職を望まず六和寺に滞在した。八月十五日の夜、銭塘江の潮の音を聞いて師の偈を悟り、身を清めて衣を改め、最後の頌を書いて坐禅のまま亡くなった。武松らによって六和塔の裏山に葬られた。

酒を飲んで寺で騒動を起こしたため、東京の大相国寺へ送られて菜園を預かった。そこで柳を根こそぎ引き抜き、林沖と義兄弟になる。林沖が流刑になるとひそかに後を追い、野猪林で救った後、滄州の手前七十余里まで護送して別れた。やがて相国寺にもいられなくなり、曹正の計略で楊志と二竜山を奪い、鄧竜を殺して山寨の首領となる。

三つの山寨が力を合わせて青州を攻めた後、魯智深は一同と梁山へ入り、歩軍の頭領を務めた。遼討伐の帰途に五台山を再訪すると、智真から「夏に逢いて擒にし、臘に遇いて執り、潮を聴いて円かに、信を見て寂す」という偈を授かる。方臘討伐では烏竜嶺で夏侯成を追って道に迷い、山中の庵へ至った。後にそこで逃亡中の方臘を生け捕りにする。

杭州まで帰ると、官職を望まず六和寺に滞在した。八月十五日の夜、銭塘江の潮の音を聞いて師の偈を悟り、身を清めて衣を改め、最後の頌を書いて坐禅のまま亡くなった。武松らによって六和塔の裏山に葬られた。

阮小二，绰号「立地太岁」，住在梁山泊边的石碣村，以打鱼为生，是阮小五、阮小七的兄长。吴用到村中相邀，三兄弟与晁盖、吴用、公孙胜、刘唐合为七人，乔装贩枣客商，另由白胜扮卖酒人配合，在黄泥冈劫取生辰纲。

事发后，三阮利用水港击退追捕官军，随晁盖投奔梁山。王伦不肯收留，林冲杀死王伦，拥晁盖为寨主。梁山排座次时，阮小二居第二十七位，应天剑星，任水军头领。

征方腊攻乌龙岭水路时，敌军顺流放下火排，后船以长枪、挠钩追击。阮小二欲下水，被挠钩搭住，怕被俘受辱，拔出腰刀自刎。

before.en:
Ruan Xiaoer, known as the Earthbound Tai Sui, was a fisherman of Shijie Village beside Liangshan Marsh and the elder brother of Ruan Xiaowu and Ruan Xiaoqi. Wu Yong recruited the three brothers for the birthday-gift robbery. With Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng, and Liu Tang, they formed the seven men disguised as date merchants; Bai Sheng separately posed as a wine seller to help them seize the convoy at Yellow Mud Ridge.

After the plot was exposed, the brothers used the waterways to defeat the pursuing officials and accompanied Chao Gai to Liangshan. When Wang Lun refused them refuge, Lin Chong killed Wang Lun and installed Chao Gai as leader. Ruan Xiaoer later ranked twenty-seventh, corresponding to the Heavenly Sword Star, and commanded naval forces.

During the Fang La campaign, enemy fire rafts swept downstream against his boats below Black Dragon Ridge, followed by vessels armed with spears and grappling hooks. As he tried to enter the water, a hook caught him. Rather than be captured and humiliated, he drew his belt knife and cut his own throat.
before.ja:
阮小二は「立地太歳」と呼ばれ、梁山泊に近い石碣村で漁を営んでいた。阮小五と阮小七の兄である。呉用の誘いを受けた三兄弟は、晁蓋、呉用、公孫勝、劉唐と合わせて七人で棗売りに扮した。別に酒売りを装った白勝の協力を得て、黄泥岡で生辰綱を奪った。

事件が発覚すると、三兄弟は水路を利用して追手を退け、晁蓋とともに梁山泊へ向かった。王倫が受け入れを拒むと、林冲が王倫を殺し、晁蓋を寨主に推した。梁山泊での席次は第二十七位、天剣星に当たり、水軍頭領を務めた。

方臘征討の烏竜嶺水路攻めでは、敵が火筏を流し、その後ろから槍や鉤を備えた船で追撃してきた。水に逃れようとした阮小二は鉤に捕らえられ、捕虜となって辱められるのを恐れ、腰刀を抜いて自刃した。

徐宁，东京金枪班教师，绰号「金枪手」，善金枪、钩镰枪法，与林冲相识。家藏雁翎金圈甲，号「赛唐猊」。梁山为破呼延灼连环马，汤隆推荐徐宁，安排时迁盗甲，再引徐宁追寻，将他麻翻送上山。

汤隆又将徐宁家眷接来，使他无法回京任职。徐宁留在梁山，传授钩镰枪法，训练步军钩斩马脚，击破连环马。排座次时居第十八位，应天祐星，列马军八骠骑兼先锋使。

征方腊攻杭州时，徐宁与郝思文出哨，遭敌军包围。他杀出后回顾郝思文被擒，颈上中了一箭，由关胜救回。箭上有毒，徐宁被送往秀州养伤，半月后不治而死。

before.en:
Xu Ning, the Golden Spear, taught the imperial Golden Spear Company in the Eastern Capital. Skilled with both ordinary and hooked lances, he knew Lin Chong and owned the treasured golden-ring armor called Sai Tang Ni. To defeat Huyan Zhuo's linked cavalry, Tang Long recommended him, arranged for Shi Qian to steal the armor, then led Xu Ning after it and had him drugged and carried to Liangshan.

Tang Long also brought Xu Ning's family to the mountain, leaving him unable to return to his post. Xu Ning stayed and taught the hooked-lance technique, training infantry to cut down the horses and break the linked cavalry. He ranked eighteenth, corresponding to the Heavenly Blessed Star, and became one of the Eight Cavalry Vanguards.

During the attack on Hangzhou against Fang La, Xu Ning and Hao Siwen were surrounded while scouting. Xu Ning fought free, but turned back when he saw Hao Siwen captured and was struck in the neck by an arrow. Guan Sheng rescued him. The arrow was poisoned; he was sent to Xiuzhou for treatment and died half a month later.
before.ja:
徐寧は東京の金槍班教師で、「金槍手」と呼ばれ、金槍と鉤鎌槍法に優れ、林冲とも知り合いだった。「賽唐猊」と呼ばれる雁翎金圏甲を家宝としていた。呼延灼の連環馬を破るため、湯隆が徐寧を推薦し、時遷に鎧を盗ませた後、追跡に誘い出して薬で眠らせ、梁山泊へ運んだ。

湯隆はさらに徐寧の家族も山へ連れてきたため、徐寧は都の任務へ戻れなくなった。梁山泊に残って鉤鎌槍法を教え、歩兵に馬の脚を斬らせ、連環馬を破った。席次は第十八位、天祐星に当たり、馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使に列した。

方臘征討の杭州攻めで郝思文と偵察に出て、敵に囲まれた。脱出した後、郝思文が捕らえられたのを見て戻ると首に矢を受け、関勝に救われた。矢には毒があり、秀州へ送られて治療を受けたが、半月後に亡くなった。

杨志，绰号「青面兽」，脸上有青记，自称三代将门之后、杨令公之孙，曾任殿司制使。押运花石纲时船在黄河翻覆，他逃难在外；获赦后想回京复职，途中与林冲交手，未接受王伦留山之邀。高俅拒绝起用，杨志只得卖刀，争执中杀死牛二，自首后刺配大名府。

梁中书赏识杨志，令他演武，战平索超，升为管军提辖。随后托他押生辰纲。进入偏僻山路后，杨志改在白天赶路，避开夜间危险，却与部下因炎热劳累发生冲突，最终同被药酒麻翻，财物遭晁盖等劫走。

杨志逃走后，与鲁智深、曹正合力夺取二龙山，后来随三山人马同上梁山。居第十七位，应天暗星，列马军八骠骑兼先锋使。

征方腊初期，杨志曾随军攻润州、进丹徒，后因病留在丹徒，不能继续出征。军队回师时传来死讯，他已葬在丹徒山园。

before.en:
Yang Zhi, the Blue-Faced Beast, bore a blue birthmark and described himself as a descendant of the Yang military family. Formerly an imperial escort officer, he lost a convoy of decorative rocks when his ship overturned on the Yellow River and went into hiding. After an amnesty, he sought reinstatement, fighting Lin Chong on the way but declining Wang Lun's offer to join Liangshan. Rejected by Gao Qiu, he tried to sell his sword, killed Niu Er in a dispute, and surrendered. He was exiled to Daming.

Governor Liang recognized his abilities, arranged a contest in which he matched Suo Chao, and promoted him to military inspector. He then entrusted Yang Zhi with the birthday gifts. On entering isolated mountain roads, Yang shifted travel to daylight to avoid nighttime danger. Heat and exhaustion caused conflict with his men, and the entire party was eventually drugged while Chao Gai's group stole the cargo.

Yang Zhi escaped and joined Lu Zhishen and Cao Zheng in taking Twin Dragons Mountain. He later entered Liangshan with the combined mountain bands. Ranked seventeenth under the Heavenly Dark Star, he became one of the Eight Cavalry Vanguards.

Early in the Fang La campaign, Yang Zhi fought at Runzhou and advanced to Dantu, where illness forced him to stay behind. On the army's return, news arrived that he had died and been buried in the hills of Dantu.
before.ja:
楊志は顔に青い痣があり、「青面獣」と呼ばれ、三代続く武門、楊令公の子孫と自称した。殿司制使だったが、花石綱の護送中に黄河で船が覆り、逃亡した。赦免後に復職を求めて都へ向かう途中、林冲と戦い、王倫の誘いは断った。高俅に拒まれて刀を売ろうとし、争いで牛二を殺して自首、大名府へ流された。

梁中書に力量を認められ、武芸試合で索超と引き分け、管軍提轄に昇進した。その後、生辰綱の護送を任される。人里離れた山道では夜の危険を避けて昼に進むよう変えたが、暑さと疲労で部下と対立し、最後は一同とも薬酒で倒され、晁蓋らに財物を奪われた。

逃れた楊志は魯智深、曹正と二竜山を奪い、後に三山の軍と梁山泊へ加わった。席次は第十七位、天暗星に当たり、馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使に列した。

方臘征討の初期には潤州攻めに参加し、丹徒へ進んだが、病気で現地に残され、先へ進めなくなった。軍の帰還時に訃報が届き、丹徒の山に葬られていたことが知らされた。

张清，东昌府守将，绰号「没羽箭」，善以飞石打人，部下有龚旺、丁得孙。梁山攻东昌时，他连打十五将，迫使宋江、卢俊义合兵用计。后出城劫粮，被林冲赶入水中，遭阮氏三兄弟擒住，受宋江礼待后归顺，并荐兽医皇甫端同上梁山。

张清居第十六位，应天捷星，列马军八骠骑兼先锋使。征田虎时，他化名全羽，进入敌方，与同样会飞石的琼英结为夫妻，合力协助平定田虎。

征方腊攻独松关时，他与伤臂的董平私自步行上关挑战。张清刺厉天闰，枪扎入松树拔不出来，被厉天闰回枪刺中腹部而死，董平也随后遇害。

before.en:
Zhang Qing, the Featherless Arrow, defended Dongchang and excelled at throwing stones. His deputies were Gong Wang and Ding Desun. He struck fifteen Liangshan commanders during the siege, forcing Song Jiang and Lu Junyi to combine their forces and use a stratagem. Lured out to seize supplies, he was driven into the water by Lin Chong and captured by the three Ruan brothers. He accepted Song Jiang's courteous welcome and recommended the veterinarian Huangfu Duan for Liangshan as well.

Zhang Qing ranked sixteenth, corresponding to the Heavenly Swift Star, and became one of the Eight Cavalry Vanguards. During the Tian Hu campaign, he infiltrated the enemy under the name Quan Yu and married Qiongying, another skilled stone-thrower. Together they helped defeat Tian Hu.

At Lone Pine Pass during the Fang La campaign, he and the wounded Dong Ping went up on foot without permission. Zhang Qing thrust at Li Tianrun, but his spear stuck in a pine tree. Unable to pull it free, he was stabbed in the abdomen and killed. Dong Ping died soon afterward.

席次は第十六位、天捷星に当たり、馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使に列した。田虎征討では全羽と名乗って敵方へ入り、同じく飛礫を使う瓊英と結婚し、ともに平定を助けた。

席次は第十六位、天捷星に当たり、馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使に列した。田虎征討では全羽と名乗って敵方へ入り、同じく飛礫を使う瓊英と結婚し、ともに平定を助けた。

方臘征討の独松関では、腕を負傷した董平と無断で徒歩のまま関へ挑んだ。厲天閏を突いた槍が松に刺さって抜けなくなり、相手の槍を腹に受けて戦死した。董平も続いて殺された。

朱贵，沂州沂水县人，称「旱地忽律」，是梁山早期头领，在山下开酒店，探听消息、接引来客。林冲持柴进书信投梁山，先遇朱贵，由他用响箭唤船渡水，并劝王伦收留林冲。晁盖等来投时，也由他接引上山。

李逵回乡接母，宋江恐他惹祸，派同乡朱贵跟随。朱贵与弟弟朱富合谋，用蒙汗药麻翻押解李逵的李云等人，救出李逵，随后带朱富家眷及李云同回梁山。

大聚义时，朱贵居第九十二位，应地囚星，与杜兴掌管南山酒店。征方腊时在杭州染疫，留下治疗，后来病故；照看病人的朱富也染病身亡。

before.en:
Zhu Gui, the Dry-Land Crocodile, came from Yishui County in Yizhou and was one of Liangshan's early commanders. His inn below the mountain gathered news and received visitors. When Lin Chong arrived with Chai Jin's letter, Zhu Gui summoned a ferry with a whistling arrow and urged Wang Lun to admit him. He also received Chao Gai's party when they came to join.

When Li Kui went home for his mother, Song Jiang feared trouble and sent Zhu Gui, a fellow native, to follow. Zhu Gui and his brother Zhu Fu drugged Li Yun and the men escorting the captured Li Kui, freeing him. They then returned to Liangshan with Zhu Fu's family and Li Yun.

At the grand assembly, Zhu Gui ranked ninety-second, corresponding to the Earthly Captive Star, and managed the southern inn with Du Xing. During the Fang La campaign, he contracted the epidemic in Hangzhou and stayed for treatment, but later died. Zhu Fu, who helped care for the sick, also fell ill and died.
before.ja:

李逵が母を迎えに帰郷すると、宋江は騒ぎを心配して同郷の朱貴を追わせた。弟の朱富とともに、捕らえられた李逵を護送する李雲らへ薬を盛り、救出した。その後、朱富の家族や李雲と梁山泊へ戻った。

大聚義では第九十二位、地囚星に当たり、杜興と南山酒店を管理した。方臘征討中に杭州で疫病にかかり、療養のため残ったが、後に病死した。看病に残った朱富も病にかかって亡くなった。

邹润，莱州人氏，绰号「独角龙」，与叔父邹渊年纪相仿，一同在登云山聚众。他身材高大，脑后生着一个肉瘤，曾在争斗中用头撞折涧边松树。原著由此介绍他的异相与绰号。

孙新、顾大嫂筹划搭救被陷害入狱的解珍、解宝时，请邹氏叔侄相助。邹润随众劫牢，救出解氏兄弟，随后与孙立等人到祝家庄作内应，帮助梁山破庄。排座次时，他列第九十一位，上应地角星，任步军将校。

征方腊攻歙州时，邹润与孙立、黄信、邹渊合战王寅，林冲赶到后，五人将王寅杀死。其后邹渊在清溪之战中遭马军踏杀，邹润则生还。受封后，他不愿为官，独自回到登云山；原著没有续写其晚年。

before.en:
Zou Run came from Laizhou and was known as the One-Horned Dragon. He and his uncle Zou Yuan, who was close to him in age, led a band on Mount Dengyun. A tall man with a fleshy lump on the back of his head, he once broke a pine beside a ravine with a headbutt during a quarrel. The novel introduces his unusual appearance and nickname through this account.

When Sun Xin and Mistress Gu planned to rescue the falsely imprisoned Xie Zhen and Xie Bao, they enlisted the uncle and nephew. Zou Run took part in the jailbreak, then infiltrated Zhu Family Manor with Sun Li and the others to help Liangshan capture it. He ranked ninety-first, corresponding to the Earthly Horn Star, and served as an infantry officer.

During the Fang La campaign at Shezhou, Zou Run joined Sun Li, Huang Xin, and Zou Yuan against Wang Yin. Lin Chong arrived, and the five killed their opponent. Zou Yuan was later trampled to death by cavalry at Qingxi, while Zou Run survived. After receiving his reward, Zou Run declined official service and returned alone to Mount Dengyun. The novel gives no further account of his later life.

鄒潤は萊州の出身で、あだ名は「独角竜」。年の近い叔父の鄒淵と、登雲山で一党を率いていた。背が高く、後頭部には肉のこぶがあり、口論の際に谷川のそばの松を頭突きで折ったことがある。原作は、この逸話とともに彼の容姿とあだ名を紹介している。

無実の罪で投獄された解珍、解宝を救うため、孫新と顧大嫂は鄒氏の叔父と甥に協力を求めた。鄒潤は牢破りに加わって兄弟を救い、その後は孫立らと祝家荘に潜り込み、内応して梁山泊の勝利を助けた。席次は第九十一位、地角星で、歩兵の将校を務めた。

方臘征伐の歙州戦では、孫立、黄信、鄒淵とともに王寅と戦い、林冲が加わると五人で討ち取った。その後、鄒淵は清渓の戦いで騎兵に踏み殺されたが、鄒潤は生還した。恩賞を受けた後は官職を望まず、一人で登雲山へ帰った。その後の晩年は語られていない。

before.en:
Zou Yuan, the Forest-Emerging Dragon, came from Laizhou. A forthright man of considerable martial skill, he had formerly lived as an idler fond of gambling. He led a band on Mount Dengyun with his nephew Zou Run, who was close to him in age. They also knew such men of the outlaw world as Yang Lin, Deng Fei, and Shi Yong.

When Sun Xin and Mistress Gu planned to break Xie Zhen and Xie Bao out of prison, Zou Yuan agreed to help and proposed seeking refuge at Liangshan afterward. Once the brothers were rescued, he joined Sun Li and the others in infiltrating Zhu Family Manor, supporting Song Jiang's attack from within. Zou Yuan ranked ninetieth at Liangshan, corresponding to the Earthly Short Star, and served as an infantry officer.

During the Fang La campaign, Zou Yuan fought at Shezhou. He, Sun Li, Huang Xin, and Zou Run surrounded Wang Yin; when Lin Chong joined them, the five killed him. In the subsequent battle at Qingxi, however, Zou Yuan and Du Qian were trampled to death by cavalry. He did not survive to receive the final rewards. It was his nephew Zou Run who later returned to Mount Dengyun.

孫新と顧大嫂が解珍、解宝を牢から救おうとした際、鄒淵は協力を引き受け、成功した後は梁山泊へ向かおうと提案した。兄弟を救い出すと、孫立らとともに祝家荘に潜入し、内側から宋江の攻撃を助けた。梁山泊では第九十位、地短星に列し、歩兵の将校を務めた。

陶宗旺，光州人，庄家田户出身，绰号「九尾龟」。他力气大，惯使铁锹，也会使枪抡刀，在黄门山与欧鹏、蒋敬、马麟聚义，居第四位。

宋江从江州脱险，攻无为军报仇后返回梁山，途经黄门山。四位头领下山相迎，款待众人，随后收拾山寨人马财物，同往梁山入伙。大聚义时，陶宗旺居第七十五位，应地理星，负责监筑梁山泊城垣。

征方腊攻润州时，陶宗旺与宋万、焦挺同在乱军中阵亡。原著合记三人被箭射死、马踏身亡，未分别详叙。宋江设祭，三人葬于润州东门外。

before.en:
Tao Zongwang, the Nine-Tailed Turtle, came from a farming household in Guangzhou Prefecture. A strong man who wielded an iron shovel as well as spear and saber, he was the fourth leader of Yellow Gate Mountain, alongside Ou Peng, Jiang Jing, and Ma Lin.

After escaping Jiangzhou and taking revenge at Wuwei, Song Jiang passed Yellow Gate Mountain on his way to Liangshan. Its four leaders welcomed and entertained the party, then gathered their followers and property and joined Liangshan. Tao Zongwang ranked seventy-fifth, corresponding to the Earthly Principles Star, and supervised the construction of the stronghold's defensive walls.

During the assault on Runzhou against Fang La, Tao Zongwang died with Song Wan and Jiao Ting. The novel collectively describes the three as killed by arrows and trampled by horses, without detailing each death separately. Song Jiang held a memorial sacrifice, and they were buried outside Runzhou's eastern gate.

王英，两淮人，因五短身材称「矮脚虎」。原是车家，途中劫取客人财物，事发后越狱，投清风山，与燕顺、郑天寿聚义，居第二位。他曾强留刘高之妻，经宋江劝说才放人，宋江也答应日后替他成婚。

清风寨事后，王英随众上梁山。攻祝家庄时被扈三娘擒住；扈三娘又被林冲擒上山。破庄后，宋江将她许配给王英。王英居第五十八位，应地微星，与扈三娘同为专掌三军内采事的马军头领。

征方腊进攻睦州途中，王英与郑彪交战，被对方法术惊住，遭一枪刺死。扈三娘上前救援，又被郑彪飞来的镀金铜砖击中面门而死。

before.en:
Wang Ying came from the Huai regions and was called the Stumpy Tiger because of his short stature. Originally a carter, he robbed a passenger, escaped prison after his arrest, and joined Yan Shun and Zheng Tianshou at Qingfeng Mountain as its second leader. He tried to keep Liu Gao's wife by force until Song Jiang persuaded him to release her and promised to arrange a marriage for him.

After the troubles at Qingfeng Fort, Wang Ying joined Liangshan. During the attack on Zhu Family Manor, Hu Sanniang captured him; Lin Chong subsequently captured her. After the manor fell, Song Jiang gave her to Wang Ying in marriage. Wang Ying ranked fifty-eighth, corresponding to the Earthly Subtle Star. He and Hu Sanniang served as cavalry leaders responsible for internal military affairs.

武松，清河县人，排行第二，称「武二郎」。他在柴进庄上结识宋江，回乡途中醉过景阳冈，徒手打死猛虎，被阳谷县任为都头。兄长武大遭潘金莲、西门庆毒害，武松取证告官不成，杀二人为兄报仇，随后投案，刺配孟州。

在孟州，他受施恩照应，醉打蒋门神，夺回快活林。张都监等陷害他，又遣人在飞云浦杀他；武松反杀押差和杀手，返回孟州血洗鸳鸯楼。张青、孙二娘给他头陀衣物与度牒，装成行者。他入二龙山，后随三山人马攻青州，同上梁山。

武松居第十四位，应天伤星，任步军头领。征方腊进至睦州一带，包道乙飞剑砍伤他的左臂，鲁智深将他救出。武松醒后自己割断将断的残臂，被送回营中养伤。

班师回杭州，武松不愿赴京，在六和寺出家，照看病中的林冲。原著记他后来八十岁善终。

before.en:
Wu Song, the second son of a family from Qinghe County, was known as Second Brother Wu. He met Song Jiang at Chai Jin's estate. On his journey home, he crossed Jingyang Ridge after drinking and killed a tiger barehanded, earning appointment as constable in Yanggu. When Pan Jinlian and Ximen Qing poisoned his elder brother Wu Da, Wu Song gathered evidence but failed to obtain justice. He killed them in revenge, surrendered, and was exiled to Mengzhou.

There Shi En befriended him. Wu Song beat Jiang the Door God while drunk and recovered Happy Grove. Officials then framed him and arranged his murder at Flying Cloud Pool. He killed the escorts and assassins, returned to Mengzhou, and carried out the killings at Mandarin Duck Tower. Zhang Qing and Sun Erniang supplied a mendicant's clothes and papers so he could escape as a pilgrim. He joined Twin Dragons Mountain, then Liangshan after the combined mountain bands took Qingzhou.

Wu Song ranked fourteenth, corresponding to the Heavenly Wounded Star, and commanded infantry. During the Fang La campaign near Muzhou, Bao Daoyi's flying sword struck his left arm. Lu Zhishen rescued him. On regaining consciousness, Wu Song severed the nearly detached limb himself and was taken back to camp.

Returning to Hangzhou, Wu Song declined to go to court. He took religious vows at Six Harmonies Temple and cared for the ailing Lin Chong. The novel states that he lived to eighty.

吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，绰号「智多星」，与晁盖自幼相识，在村中教书，也使两条铜链。他参与谋取生辰纲，邀阮氏三兄弟入局；晁盖等七人扮枣商，白胜另扮卖酒人，用蒙汗药麻翻押运者，夺走财物。

上梁山后，吴用趁王伦拒纳之机激发林冲不满，林冲杀王伦，晁盖成为寨主。吴用继而担任军师，参与祝家庄、大名府等战役。他曾假扮算命先生，在卢俊义家题下藏着反意的诗，引他外出避祸，使其卷入梁山计策。

大聚义时，吴用居第三位，应天机星，与公孙胜掌管机密军师职事。招安后随军征战，方腊平定后受授武胜军承宣使。

吴用梦见宋江、李逵诉说被毒死的冤情，赶赴楚州蓼儿洼，在宋江墓前遇到也因梦而来的花荣。二人追念宋江恩义，一同在墓旁树上自缢，葬在墓侧。

before.en:
Wu Yong, courtesy name Xuejiu and styled Master Jialiang, was known as the Resourceful Star. A village teacher and Chao Gai's friend since childhood, he also wielded two copper chains. He helped plan the birthday-gift robbery and recruited the Ruan brothers. Chao Gai's seven men posed as date merchants, while Bai Sheng separately played the wine seller; drugged wine allowed them to seize the convoy's valuables.

At Liangshan, Wu Yong encouraged Lin Chong's discontent with Wang Lun's refusal to admit them. Lin Chong killed Wang Lun, and Chao Gai became leader. Wu Yong served as strategist in campaigns including Zhu Family Manor and Daming. Disguised as a fortune-teller, he wrote a poem with a concealed rebellious message at Lu Junyi's house and persuaded him to travel to avoid disaster, drawing him into Liangshan's scheme.

At the grand assembly, Wu Yong ranked third, corresponding to the Heavenly Intelligence Star, and shared responsibility for military strategy with Gongsun Sheng. After the amnesty he accompanied the campaigns and, following Fang La's defeat, was appointed military commissioner of Wusheng Army.

In a dream, Song Jiang and Li Kui told him they had been poisoned. Wu Yong went to Song Jiang's grave at Liaorwa in Chuzhou and met Hua Rong, drawn there by a similar dream. Remembering Song Jiang's kindness, they hanged themselves together from a tree beside the grave and were buried nearby.

梁山泊では王倫の拒絶を機に林冲の不満をあおり、林冲が王倫を殺して晁蓋が寨主となった。その後は軍師として祝家荘、大名府などの戦いに関わった。占い師を装って盧俊義の家に反意を隠した詩を書き、災難を避ける旅に出るよう勧め、梁山泊の計略へ巻き込んだこともある。

At the grand assembly he ranked eighty-second, corresponding to the Earthly Demon Star, and guarded the first pass on the southern approach.

Soon after the army crossed the river in the Fang La campaign, Song Wan, Jiao Ting, and Tao Zongwang died during the taking of Runzhou. The novel collectively describes them as killed by arrows and trampled by horses, without assigning a separate account to each man. Song Jiang held a memorial sacrifice, and the three were buried outside Runzhou's eastern gate.
